brand.$description: The brand color: buttons and solid fills.

on-brand.$description: Icons and large or bold text on a brand (teal-10) fill, in both themes, such as the theme switch's chosen icon (4.4:1). Small body-size text on teal needs a teal-11 fill instead (5.5:1).

link.$description: Links and teal text such as the date line.
